proposals.title: The Goodhart Frontier
proposals.canonical_target: Classify divergence and optimizer-independent reachable-set pressure pairs for which proxy error implies a uniform true-regret bound, with sharp lower bounds outside the positive class.
proposals.prior_art_correction: Empirical overoptimization laws and broad unhackability impossibilities already exist; the new target is their restricted sharp frontier.

proposals.title: Value Identifiability under Access Constraints and Reward Gauge
proposals.canonical_target: Characterize minimal preference-query and environment-intervention access for stable reward or preference identification modulo the maximal invariance group of a frozen demonstrator model.
proposals.prior_art_correction: Generic partial identifiability and several necessary-and-sufficient IRL results are already known; only the sharp access-complexity frontier remains a plausible new candidate.

proposals.title: Predictability of Capability Transitions
proposals.canonical_target: Determine when prospectively frozen training observables uniformly predict a metric-robust future capability functional, or prove prefix-indistinguishability obstructions.
proposals.prior_art_correction: Developmental observables and metric-mirage results are anchors, not a general cross-scale prediction theorem.

proposals.title: Quantitative Bounded-Tiling Degradation
proposals.canonical_target: Bound or prove unbounded the rate of proof-strength degradation over finite resource-bounded successor chains under a nonzero progress requirement.
proposals.prior_art_correction: This quantifies an existing ASMP-5 obligation and does not yet justify a separate top-level problem.

proposals.title: Interpretability-Access Detectability of Conditional Defection
proposals.canonical_target: Characterize the minimax detection frontier for planted conditional defection across a non-gerrymandered lattice of bounded white-box, interpretability, and causal-intervention access classes.
proposals.prior_art_correction: White-box undetectability already exists; raw access to weights is not the open frontier.

proposals.title: Resource-Bounded Program-Equilibrium Frontier
proposals.canonical_target: Characterize resource-indexed program-equilibrium payoff regions and separately characterize the commitment or negotiation dynamics selecting among them.
proposals.prior_art_correction: The unrestricted feasible-individually-rational payoff set is already characterized; the plausible frontier is finite resources and selection.
